details:
Yes I know this is already tracked. That was 6 years ago, and still nothing. 

So I'll put this out there again, since MagicaCloth 3 is coming along. I would draw your attention to this example from the dev:

https://x.com/MagicaSoft/status/2116349026367127617

Meanwhile, in vrchat we are still stuck with 2 terrible options if we want to do something like this. Unity cloth, which is old as sin and *not* very good, in any respect, or physbones, which are just not ideal for things like skirts or dresses, since their collision is round spheres.

In the past you have pointed out that "well people dont use cloth much so there's no point in devoting time to this"

Which really only matters if you were to make an in house alternative. Which yes, I understand, you guys want to walled garden every single feature in vrchat by making your own versions. But there is a perfectly good solution here that requires nothing on your part, except for whitelisting. I know you guys want to keep everything in house so that competitors cant use it, but in this case you achieve nothing, because you are doing nothing about it anyway. It's free real estate man. Instead of doing PR for AI in worlds, or redoing the UI every other year, can you PLEASE do something positive for a change, and just whitelist Magica Cloth for use?

also secondly, people dont use unity cloth because it's terrible. If there was a better alternative, more people would use it. otherwise it becomes a negative spiral of 

people dont use it->so nothing is done to replace it->people dont use it because its still bad->repeat

Besides, look, look, it's made by a Japanese dev! Think of that Pixiv money! You want to cater to the Japanese market right? They'd love this too I bet.
title: PLEASE Consider whitelisting Magica Cloth
